# Leeward Design System

> Open-source, AI-ready design system for digital banking, built around the Leeward brand. React components, semantic design tokens and rules that keep generated banking screens on-brand and accessible.

Use components from @leeward/react, style only with var(--lw-*) semantic tokens, render money with AmountDisplay, and never use em dashes in copy.

Designed and directed by Kemal Salih Carfi (https://kscarfi.com).

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/kscarfi/leeward-design-system/blob/main/AGENTS.md): read first. How to design and build Leeward screens: workflow, which component for which need, tokens, sizes, layout, banking, accessibility and copy rules, checklist
- [Screen recipes](https://github.com/kscarfi/leeward-design-system/tree/main/docs/recipes): complete screens that compile: home, transfer, transaction details, settings, loading, empty and error states
- [DESIGN.md](https://github.com/kscarfi/leeward-design-system/blob/main/DESIGN.md): principles, token rules, layout, copy, accessibility, component list
- [components.manifest.json](https://github.com/kscarfi/leeward-design-system/blob/main/components.manifest.json): every component with props, variants, do and don't rules, accessibility and an example
- [Contrast report](https://github.com/kscarfi/leeward-design-system/blob/main/docs/contrast-report.md): WCAG 2.2 and APCA results for every token pair

## Tools

- [MCP server](https://github.com/kscarfi/leeward-design-system/tree/main/packages/mcp-server): get_tokens, get_component, search_components, get_guidelines, validate_ui
- [Tokens](https://github.com/kscarfi/leeward-design-system/tree/main/packages/tokens/dist): CSS variables, typed TS and Figma variables

## Optional

- [Decisions](https://github.com/kscarfi/leeward-design-system/tree/main/docs/decisions): why the system is built this way
- [Build log](https://github.com/kscarfi/leeward-design-system/blob/main/docs/build-log.md): time spent and AI mistakes
